title: Please Take the First Step
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个人要到另外一个美丽的城市去，那个城市很近，走路只要1个小时。正因为近，这个人就不着急，始终不愿意迈出第一步。他每天要喝茶，要看电视，要听音乐……总之，要做的事情太多了，他太忙了。
他没有忘记自己还要赶路，可是真到下决心要走时，就又安慰自己："反正1个小时就到了，不用着急。”
就这样，虽然那个美丽的城市很近，但是这个人一生都没能到达目的地。不迈出第一步，再近也到不了呀！
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個人要到另外一個美麗的城市去，那個城市很近，走路只要1個小時。正因為近，這個人就不著急，始終不願意邁出第一步。他每天要喝茶，要看電視，要聽音樂……總之，要做的事情太多了，他太忙了。
他沒有忘記自己還要趕路，可是真到下決心要走時，就又安慰自己："反正1個小時就到了，不用著急。”
就這樣，雖然那個美麗的城市很近，但是這個人一生都沒能到達目的地。不邁出第一步，再近也到不了呀！
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī gè rén yào dào lìng wài yī gè měi lì de chéng shì qù， nà gè chéng shì hěn jìn， zǒu lù zhǐ yào 1 gè xiǎo shí。 zhèng yīn wèi jìn， zhè gè rén jiù bù zháo jí， shǐ zhōng bù yuàn yì mài chū dì yī bù。 tā měi tiān yào hē chá， yào kàn diàn shì， yào tīng yīn yuè …… zǒng zhī， yào zuò de shì qing tài duō le， tā tài máng le。
tā méi yǒu wàng jì zì jǐ hái yào gǎn lù， kě shì zhēn dào xià jué xīn yào zǒu shí， jiù yòu ān wèi zì jǐ：" fǎn zhèng 1 gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le， bù yòng zháo jí。”
jiù zhè yàng， suī rán nà gè měi lì de chéng shì hěn jìn， dàn shì zhè gè rén yī shēng dōu méi néng dào dá mù dì dì。 bù mài chū dì yī bù， zài jìn yě dào bù liǎo ya！
english_paragraphs: There is a person who wants to go to another beautiful city. That city is very close and only takes an hour to walk. Precisely because it is close, this person is not in a hurry and is never willing to take the first step. He drinks tea, watches TV, and listens to music every day... In short, there are too many things to do and he is too busy.
He didn't forget that he still had to go on his way, but when he really made up his mind to leave, he comforted himself: "We'll be there in an hour anyway, don't worry."
In this way, although the beautiful city was very close, the man could not reach his destination in his life. If you don't take the first step, you won't get any closer!
english_full:
There is a person who wants to go to another beautiful city. That city is very close and only takes an hour to walk. Precisely because it is close, this person is not in a hurry and is never willing to take the first step. He drinks tea, watches TV, and listens to music every day... In short, there are too many things to do and he is too busy.

He didn't forget that he still had to go on his way, but when he really made up his mind to leave, he comforted himself: "We'll be there in an hour anyway, don't worry."

In this way, although the beautiful city was very close, the man could not reach his destination in his life. If you don't take the first step, you won't get any closer!
